name: Cards
author: CatVinci-Studio
description: For notes you keep in order: quotes, code, tables and callouts each sit in a rounded card on a soft grey page, with an indigo accent, and level-2 headings open a section over a rule. Layout and colours after Border, our own CSS.

zh.description: 适合整理笔记：引用、代码、表格和提示块各自放在圆角卡片里，浅灰底色配靛蓝点缀，二级标题下方有分隔线另起一节。版式与配色参考 Border，CSS 为我们自己编写。
